name: Create Kafka Topic
description: Create a new Kafka topic with specified parameters.

environment_variables.name: TOPIC_NAME
environment_variables.description: The name of the Kafka topic to create

environment_variables.name: PUBLISHER
environment_variables.description: The name/identifier of the publisher service or application

environment_variables.name: SUBSCRIBERS
environment_variables.description: Comma-separated list of subscriber services or applications that will consume from this topic (e.g., "service1,service2,service3")

environment_variables.name: THROUGHPUT
environment_variables.description: Expected throughput. Used to calculate optimal number of partitions for the topic
